name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-styled-amazing-flyin-hammer-bro
title: Alternative Redrawn Styled Amazing Flyin' Hammer Bro.
description:
If the look on SMW Redrawn's Hammer Brother graphic was too much like the other typical hammer brothers on their land counterparts and you still want to maintain consistency with the Redrawn art style for your projects, you come to the right place.

I recently made an alternative to that, heavily based off of Super Princess Peach's take of the Amazing Flyin' Hammer Brother, because as it turns out, the weird way it's face is...is intentional by design.

Read the text file on the differences, as it contains various alternatives. Extract this to GFX13. Do give credit if used.
